_meta.description: Where the automatic news and video feed looks, and what it keeps. Edited by hand; read by scripts/fetch-feed.mjs every 6 hours (.github/workflows/feed.yml). Only outlets' own RSS feeds and the YouTube Data API are used: Google News RSS is for personal feed readers only, so it is not used.

match.comment: An item is kept if its title matches a 'line_12' pattern, or its title names a 'corridor' place and its summary matches a 'line_12' pattern. Case does not matter. 'line[\s-]*12\b' does not match Line 12A.
